```{=html}
<style>

/* Remove Quarto width limits */
#quarto-content main {
  max-width: none;
  padding: 0;
}

/* Full-width background hero */
.full-hero {
  position: relative;
  left: 50%;
  right: 50%;
  margin-left: -50vw;
  margin-right: -50vw;
  width: 100vw;

  min-height: 100vh;

  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;

  text-align: center;

  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.35), rgba(0,0,0,0.35)),
    url("images/home_photo.png");

  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}

/* Welcome text */

.welcome-text {
  font-size: 7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: #ffffff;
  text-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);

  animation: slideIn 2s ease-out;
}

/* Slide animation */

@keyframes slideIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(80px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

</style>
```
